mapper.sql: id, supplier, supplier_hotel_code, hotel_name, active, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hotel_mapping (supplier, supplier_hotel_code, hotel_name, active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{supplier}, #{supplierHotelCode}, #{hotelName}, TRUE, NOW(), NOW()) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), hotel_name = new.hotel_name, active = TRUE, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT FROM hotel_mapping WHERE supplier = #{supplier} AND active = TRUE ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM hotel_mapping WHERE active = TRUE ORDER BY id
